'''The Seat of Desolation''' is an area located upon the [[Rock of Desolation]] within the [[Tower of Karazhan]] raid. It is where [[Kruul]], Highlord of the [[Burning Legion]], can be fought. After Kruul's defeat, a portal opens up that leads to the [[Hand of Mephistroth]].
